# Generated by holes.py: one repaint prompt per hole, each with its own layout guide.

# hole 1: Tortoise Trot
@ref guide_01.png
Repaint this color-coded layout map as an overhead photograph looking straight down at a layered cut-paper pop-up book page showing a mini golf hole in a spring meadow. Keep the exact layout and position of every shape. The light green area becomes a sheet of bright spring-green card; the cream border becomes raised cream card strips standing on edge; the dark green outside becomes layers of deep green paper cut into leafy bushes, grass tufts, yellow buttercups and red poppies; the tan ovals become sand traps of yellow paper with punched dots; the black circle becomes the cup with a red paper flag on a white pin; the white rectangle becomes a white paper tee mat. Each layer casts a soft shadow on the one below, soft light from the top left, crisp clean edges, bright colours, no animals, no text, no people.
